title: Variant landscape
brief: An interactive needle / lollipop plot of the pathogenic-variant landscape of cystic fibrosis along the CFTR protein (UniProt P13569, 1,480 aa; OMIM 219700). CFTR is drawn as a horizontal domain track to residue scale from real UniProt sequence features — TMD1 (78-358), NBD1 (423-646), the disordered R region (654-831), TMD2 (859-1155) and NBD2 (1210-1443) — with a curated, individually ClinVar-verified panel of 18 well-documented CF variants placed as lollipops at their true residue positions: height encodes reported CF-cohort allele frequency, colour encodes ClinVar germline classification on a clinical significance ramp (pathogenic-red to benign-blue, the only colour). The plot marks the two mutation hotspots (the NBD1 folding/gating cluster and the NBD2 cluster) and foregrounds F508del (c.1521_1523del, p.Phe508del, ~70% of alleles worldwide, the single dominant disease allele) beside I507del, G542X, G551D, R553X, R560T, and the class-I nonsense and class-II/III missense spread across NBD1/NBD2, plus the context-dependent R117H (conflicting/risk, poly-T-modulated) and the benign M470V polymorphism. Hovering a lollipop reveals the variant detail (HGVS c./p., molecular consequence, significance, condition, domain and ClinVar Variation ID); significance chips filter the view; a domain legend and a stats panel (18 variants plotted, % pathogenic, the NBD1 hotspot, 1,085 CFTR2 disease-causing variants) complete the panel. Every HGVS string, consequence, classification and Variation ID (F508del VCV7105, G542X 7115, G551D 7120, N1303K 7129, W1282X 7136, R1162X 7137 and the rest) was verified against ClinVar (NM_000492.4 / NP_000483.3), UniProt P13569 and the CFTR2 registry on 3 July 2026, with working links. Research and education, not medical advice.
da: Genome-browser panel on a crisp cool-white ground with a fine baseline grid and graphite text; Archivo grotesque for display over Azeret Mono for all HGVS and residue notation; a single clinical significance colour scale (pathogenic-red -> likely/mild -> neutral-graphite VUS -> benign-blue) as the ONLY colour; a horizontal protein axis with domain blocks drawn to residue scale, dashed hotspot bands, a frequency y-ruler and lollipop needles rising from the track - a precise, track-based genomics look, structurally distinct (horizontal track + needles) from every other library piece and from the three prior Curie pieces (the lab-white 3D viewer, the light clinical graph, the warm oxblood dossier).
